item.tib: sgrib sbyong snying po'i mtshon dpe gtam rgyud kyi smar khrid gzhan phan mdzub tshugs
item.coloph: ces pa 'di dang ('ang) sngon byon gyi dam pa gong ma rnams kyis mtshon pa gtam rgyud kyi sgo nas smar zid 'debs pa'i phyag len dang mthun par tshogs su bshad khrid bgyid pa'i her ma bor dmigs nas gdul bya blo dman rnams la phan pa'i sems kyis kun nas bslangs te khod spungs dbra zhig ston pa bskal (skal) bzang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan nas nyer bar bris pa'o//
